text_block_list.text:
Голд Шипп doesn't seem like herself
today.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Mystery Adventures got canceled! It was my favorite show!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Now they'll never feature me as one of
the seven
wonders of the world...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Голд Шипп takes a while to recover from
the
devastating news.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
